headline: BCCI officially notifies IPL franchises of the November 15 retention submission deadline for IPL 2027.
context: Governing Council confirms each franchise may retain up to 6 players including maximum 5 capped and 2 uncapped, with Right-to-Match (RTM) options at the December mini-auction.

headline: Franchise total salary purse expanded to ₹120.00 Cr for the IPL 2027 cycle.
context: A ₹5 Cr increment over the previous season gives teams increased auction bidding flexibility while enforcing strict minimum spend thresholds of 75%.

headline: MS Dhoni confirms availability for IPL 2027 in uncapped retention bracket for Chennai Super Kings.
context: ESPNCricinfo reports CSK management has submitted provisional paperwork retaining Dhoni under the 5-year international retirement clause at ₹4.00 Cr.

headline: Royal Challengers Bengaluru set to structure core around Rajat Patidar and Devdutt Padikkal alongside Virat Kohli.
context: Cricbuzz reports RCB leadership views Patidar and Padikkal as non-negotiable domestic batting anchors to preserve continuity ahead of the 2027 mini-auction.

headline: Mumbai Indians lock Rohit Sharma as cultural Icon; Naman Dhir elevated to Priority Retain status.
context: CricField tactical analysis projects MI retaining Rohit at ₹16.30 Cr for franchise identity while preserving emerging finisher Naman Dhir ahead of auction bids.

headline: Kolkata Knight Riders projected to retain Sunil Narine as Icon with young Indian trio Rinku, Harshit, and Angkrish.
context: CRR model indicates KKR retains maximum tactical surplus by locking young domestic pace and finishing firepower before testing market depth.

headline: Delhi Capitals and Lucknow Super Giants in advanced exploratory discussions for blockbuster Rishabh Pant - Kuldeep Yadav swap.
context: Multiple trade desk sources suggest negotiations are active subject to player consent and IPL Governing Council financial reconciliation. Not yet officially approved.

headline: Sunrisers Hyderabad evaluating release of Jaydev Unadkat and Brydon Carse to optimize overseas pace slots.
context: SRH expected to prioritize Cummins, Head, Klaasen, and Abhishek, freeing purse allocations for high-impact death bowling specialists at the auction.
